title: Beating Intermediate Bots with NO QUEEN
summary: Tony plays White without his queen against the chess.com intermediate bot ladder: Maria (1000), then 1100, 1200, 1300 (Vin) and the 1400 'final boss' David. He uses a passive hippo setup (d3, knights to centre) to avoid trades, beats the first four and draws David by threefold repetition.
rules: Normal chess, but White starts without the queen (d1 empty).
Ladder of 5 bots: 1000 (Maria), 1100, 1200, 1300 (Vin), 1400 (David); beat one to advance.
win_condition: Beat each bot in turn; finale vs David 1400 (video ended in a draw by repetition).
